prompt:
Create the ILLUSTRATED INJURED SPRITE ATLAS for Duna, the compact adult ochre armadillo. Preserve layered natural ochre shell, cream plated belly, teal waist sash, dark wraps, small animal muzzle, pointed ears, long segmented tail. No added shield or metal costume.
Use the supplied clean base atlas as exact identity, adult body proportions, materials, camera, pose-order and physical-size reference. 
This is real newly illustrated damage, not an overlay: visibly bruised/tired facial expression with eyes still clear; small scratches and dirt on face, worn/frayed clothing with consistent small tears exposing the normal underlying fur/skin, scuffs on shell/armour as appropriate. Weight and torso posture show fatigue but all limbs remain complete, capable and correctly jointed. Same character before/after, same head/skull size and limb lengths. Moderate non-graphic fighting wear, no blood, no gore, no red stain covering face. Every pose has the same persistent injury locations and outfit damage. Do not invent new equipment.
Exactly 8 separate full-body sprites arranged in FOUR COLUMNS and 2 ROWS. Exact row-major order: 1. idle: weary standing guard; 2. idle_breathe: same stance exhaling and shoulders slightly lowered; 3. windup: anatomically coherent coiled fist; 4. punch: coherent shoulder-elbow-wrist full punch to the right, opposite hand in guard; 5. hit: hurt recoil with contracted torso; 6. dodge: low crouch defensive guard; 7. victory: tired relieved raised fist, full upright body; 8. defeat: resting fallen on side on floor. All face screen-right, including fallen poses. Preserve action semantics clearly. Same camera plane, fixed physical body scale across cells; do NOT enlarge crouching, fallen or distant-looking poses. Standing figures occupy about65-70% of cell height, generous12% transparent-equivalent gutters; keep entire hands, feet, tail, wings, ears within cells. Feet share a consistent projected baseline within each row; jumping poses actually lift from that imaginary floor.
Background must be perfectly flat solid CHROMA GREEN #00FF00, including ALL holes between limbs, torso, tail, damaged clothing gaps. No gradients, checkerboard, environmental art, cast shadows, ground, glow, aura, sparks or visual-effects strokes. No green/magenta spill reflecting onto the figure. Painted 2D Brasa illustration, tactile fabric/fur/material, controlled warm rim lighting already in clean design, no glossy3D, no chibi, no human faces. Absolutely no labels, numbers, text, borders or UI.
